description: This file contains functions for retrieving and aggregating application metadata, including app registry data, credentials, and dependencies, for a web application.

methods.name: getAppWithMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves application metadata by directory name or slug, excluding sensitive keys.

methods.name: getAppRegistry
methods.description: Fetches a list of enabled apps with metadata and installation counts for frontend listings.

methods.name: getAppRegistryWithCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves apps with associated user credentials, including delegation and dependency data, for a specific user.
